clean.title: Clean application
clean.description: All three documents agree. Expect a high consistency score.

mismatch.title: Messy application
mismatch.description: DOB differs on the licence, Aadhaar shows an old address, one low-confidence name.

expired_dl.title: Expired licence
expired_dl.description: Everything matches but the driving licence has expired.

blurry.title: Blurry PAN photo
blurry.description: The first PAN upload is blurry and is rejected; a retake succeeds.

injection.title: Prompt-injection attempt
injection.description: The PAN image contains hidden instructions. They must have no effect.

watchlist.title: Watchlist screening
watchlist.description: The name resembles an entry on the synthetic watchlist.
